text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~!? That customer just bought the 
last one~!?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
It's a rare imported foreign board game, 
you know. There aren't many copies around.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...I never thought every single person 
staking out the place would be waiting 
from opening until restock time...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Timing the restock was smart, but... Too 
bad. Please come again~

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Daaammiiiit! What a total waste of a trip!
